name: Flower Garden
source:
When Kobayashi Chiaki, a short and serious young girl, gets a scholarship to attend St. Marie’s Academy for girls, she decides this will be the turning point in her life. She’ll bloom into a fair and elegant lady, and leave behind her old, shabby lifestyle!

However, becoming a true ‘lady’ proves to be quite difficult… especially when she gets a crush on the school idol, Chizuru, who is hiding a dark secret…

A light and fluffy shoujo ai visual novel, suitable for all ages, with lots of cute girls doing cute things, and having cute crushes on each other!

[From [url=http://ebi-hime.tumblr.com/post/77972204730/flower-garden-download]official site[/url]]
translation:
矮小而認真的少女小林千秋獲得了聖瑪麗女子學院的獎學金。她認為這將成為人生的轉折點：蛻變成美麗優雅的淑女，告別過去寒酸的生活！

然而，成為真正的「淑女」並不容易……尤其是當她喜歡上了隱藏著黑暗秘密的校園偶像千鶴之後……

這是一部輕鬆可愛的百合視覺小說，全年齡向，講述許多可愛的女孩做著可愛的事情，並彼此萌生可愛的愛意！
